name: Dozen Ctrl
description: 4×3 latched MIDI CC banks for one synth on one channel
storage: CV destination layer per channel (default Main)

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — four CC values on the active device map (slots M1–M4)
Third (hold any channel button) — slots T1–T4 on all four channels
Values latch per layer and persist in scene storage

sections.heading: CV in
items: Each channel’s CV jack (±5 V) bipolar-adds onto that channel’s CV destination layer (default Main), same law as Rnd Plus
MIDI always tracks the destination layer’s CC with CV applied; if the UI latch layer differs, its CC is sent unmodulated when it changes
Top/Bottom LEDs show the effective value on the UI layer (CV included when UI layer matches the destination)

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Hold any channel button — Third for all four channels (hue −20° on Top/Bottom)
Shift (no button held) — Alt on all four channels (hue +20°)
Long press (no Shift) — cycles that channel’s CV destination Main → Alt → Third → Main; button flashes the new dest accent ~300 ms
Shift + channel button short tap (no fader move) — resets that channel’s Main, Alt, and Third values to 0; sends CC 0 on all three slots when MIDI Out is set
Button LED — UI layer accent (Main = Color), brightness = effective latched value on the UI layer

sections.heading: Params
items: Device — loads ★ suggested CCs into M/A/T slots when changed (full map in Presetpunk / device-cc-catalog.json)
One MIDI channel + Out for the whole 4×3 bank
Slot CC numbers are editable; catalog lists every known CC with ★ / Hidden · / Panel · prefixes

channels.jackDescription: ±5 V bipolar add onto this channel’s CV destination layer.
channels.faderDescription: Latches the slot for this channel in the global UI layer; CV modulates MIDI on the per-channel destination layer.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Shift with no button held — Alt on all four.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Hold any button — Third on all four.
channels.fnDescription: Long press cycles CV dest; Shift+short tap resets M/A/T.

channels.jackDescription: Channel 2 — same bipolar CV dest modulation.
Channel 3 — same bipolar CV dest modulation.
Channel 4 — same bipolar CV dest modulation.
